summary: Lincoln County lookout in the Kootenai National Forest with a 1930 L-4 cab, abandoned in 1942; the Montana list marks it gone.

facts.agency: Kootenai National Forest (named on the firelookout.com page; role not stated)
facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes what remains on the mountain today

events.note: Page dates the L-4 cab to 1930

evidence.supports: agency named as Kootenai National Forest
L-4 cab dated 1930; abandoned 1942; marked gone
page title calls it a fire lookout cabin
Montana list: ground type, status gone, coordinates

notes_for_editor: Only the firelookout.com page and the FFLA Montana list support this story. Two web searches turned up only Sugarloaf Peak in Washington and unrelated Montana lookouts (Mount Henry, Mount Wam, McGuire Mountain); none is this site, so none is used. The page gives no date for 'Gone', so no event was written for it. Coordinates and ground type come from the FFLA list and were not checked on a map.
